sloka: अवज्ञया च राजर्षिः परिभूय च भार्गव ।मय्यवज्ञां प्रयुङ्क्ते हि न च मां बहु मन्यते ।। ७.५८.२१ ॥
transliteration: avajñayā ca rājarṣiḥ paribhūya ca bhārgava ।mayyavajñāṁ prayuṅkte hi na ca māṁ bahu manyate ।। 7.58.21 ॥

translations.english: Indrani further complains to Chyavana, stating that the royal sage Nahusha, having insulted her, indeed shows disrespect towards her and does not regard her highly.
